svg.title: Temperature, colour and a Hertzsprung-Russell diagram of processes
svg.desc: Temperature against CPU with spectral classes, a synthetic machine on a Hertzsprung-Russell diagram with the fitted main sequence, and blackbody colours.
svg.text: hr: from CPU and memory to a star
T = 2400 K (1 + cpu/5)^0.47, m = -2.5 log10(memory / 1 GiB); class from T, luminosity class from the residual of a Theil-Sen fit.
Theil-Sen fit: m = 9.64 -2.17 log10 T; classes: II 9, III 15, IV 31, V 84, VI 31, D 3
Blackbody colour, 1,000 K to 40,000 K (log scale)
